quiz.title: Class 12 Maths Term 1 Mock Test
quiz.intro: Eight Term 1 questions spanning relations and functions, inverse trigonometry, matrices, determinants, continuity and derivatives. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.
quiz.about: Class 12 Maths Term 1 (relations, inverse trig, matrices, determinants, calculus)

questions.q: How many one-one functions are there from a set with 3 elements to a set with 4 elements?
questions.explanation: The first element has 4 choices, the second 3, the third 2, so 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 one-one functions.

questions.q: What is the principal value of sin−¹(1/2)?
questions.explanation: sin−¹ returns a value in [−π/2, π/2]. Since sin(π/6) = 1/2, the principal value is π/6.

questions.q: If A is a 2 × 3 matrix and B is a 3 × 4 matrix, what is the order of the product AB?
questions.explanation: For AB the inner dimensions (3 and 3) must match, and the product takes the outer dimensions: 2 × 4.

questions.q: If A is a 3 × 3 matrix with det(A) = 2, what is det(2A)?
questions.explanation: For an n × n matrix, det(kA) = kⁿ det(A). Here det(2A) = 2³ × 2 = 8 × 2 = 16.

questions.q: At x = 0, the function f(x) = |x| is:
questions.explanation: |x| has no break, so it is continuous, but the left and right derivatives at 0 are −1 and +1, so it is not differentiable there.

questions.q: On which interval is f(x) = x² increasing?
questions.explanation: f′(x) = 2x, which is positive when x > 0. So x² is increasing on (0, ∞).

questions.q: A relation on a set that is reflexive, symmetric and transitive is called:
questions.explanation: A relation with all three properties — reflexive, symmetric and transitive — is by definition an equivalence relation.

questions.q: For a differentiable function, at a point of local maximum the value of f′(x) is:
questions.explanation: At an interior local maximum of a differentiable function the tangent is horizontal, so f′(x) = 0 (a first-order necessary condition).

faq.q: What topics does the Class 12 Maths Term 1 syllabus usually cover?
faq.a: Term 1 typically includes relations and functions, inverse trigonometric functions, matrices, determinants, continuity and differentiability, and applications of derivatives. Check your board's latest circular, as the split can change year to year.

faq.q: How should I prepare for a Class 12 Maths mock test?
faq.a: Revise each chapter's key results first, then solve mixed sets under a timer. A short mock like this one is useful for spotting weak areas quickly before you move to full-length papers.

faq.q: Are inverse trigonometry questions important for Term 1?
faq.a: Yes. Principal-value and simplification questions from inverse trigonometry appear almost every year and are usually quick marks once you know the standard ranges.

faq.q: How much weight do matrices and determinants carry?
faq.a: Together they form a substantial part of Term 1, covering order and products of matrices, properties of determinants, and applications such as solving linear equations. They reward careful, error-free calculation.
